title: Finger off the smartphone - an intervention study in clinical samples focusing on problematic media use
summary: Patients of a psychiatric clinic will reduce their daily smartphone use time by 60 minutes for one week. It will be assessed whether this intervention contributes to their mental health level immediately after the intervention as well as two and four weeks later.

interventions.name: Intervention group: Patients of a psychiatric clinic will reduce their daily smartphone use time by 60 minutes for one week

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Daily Smartphone use of at least 60 minutes
Exclusion criteria:
None
